before: A checkpoint load gave each restored record of a container's properties its suggestion's order. A record made later for an older suggestion (a height on its author's own new row after another person's height, a direct height after a record another took) moved under the records made before it, so the shown height and the change record's old properties changed after a fold.
after: Restored records take new seqs in the manifest's order, the order they were made; a record a takeover put back takes the seq of the record that took it, as before.
reason: Change messages, the change log and the Yjs format do not change; the checkpoint's manifest does not change; its load reads the order the manifest already lists. A room admits only clients of its own code version.
